BranchPicker.note: Resting trigger: h-8 rounded-xl surface-control pill with the truncating label and the muted ChevronDown — the component's default state, correctly styled.

WithLeadingIcon.note: leading slot renders the cloud glyph ahead of the label; the trigger keeps its layout with three items in the row.

Disabled.note: disabled dims the whole trigger including the leading icon; visibly distinct from the two enabled cells.

OpenMenu.note: The open popover: search field with its Search glyph, four branch rows each with a muted detail line, and the Check trailing the selected row. This is the composition the component actually exists for.
